title: Dilution Bench installation and operational qualification

access.purpose: Exercise the public local dilution workbench with synthetic preparation data.

obligations.statement: Reachable public form and named health response.
Three-place display with unrounded stored arithmetic.
Complete two-record CSV: headers, ASCII ordering, values, units, precision and row count.
Independent baseline mass-balance calculation and three-place result display.
Normalize target ug/mL to mg/mL before calculating.
Normalize stock ug/mL to mg/mL before calculating.
Convert microlitres to mL before dilution calculation.
Equality is valid and requires no diluent.
Reject zero final volume at both interfaces without retention.
Required positive finite numerical fields and maximum canonical value. Exact rejected examples are listed in the procedure.
Target cannot exceed stock; unrecognized units are rejected.
One and 32-character boundaries, permitted punctuation and whitespace trimming.
Reject empty, overlength and syntactically invalid identifiers.
Uppercase and lowercase single-character IDs both remain present.
Trimmed duplicate is rejected with the specified error; one unchanged original row remains.
Normalized inputs and outputs are retained once and displayed after navigation.
Quantities exactly at the canonical maximum are accepted.

cases.title: Public workbench and health response
prerequisites: Start the complete protocol against an empty workspace. Preserve case order; CSV export is checked before later cases create records. Use synthetic data only.

steps.instruction: Open the public preparation page and inspect the health response.

cases.title: CSV worksheet contents and rounding
prerequisites: Start the complete protocol against an empty workspace. Preserve case order; CSV export is checked before later cases create records. Use synthetic data only.

steps.instruction: Save EXPORT-Z with 10 mg/mL stock, 2 mg/mL target, and 10 mL final volume.
Save EXPORT-A second, using 3 mg/mL stock, 1 mg/mL target and 1 mL final volume; verify independently rounded results.
Download the CSV; compare every header and row, including ASCII ordering, units, rounding and absence of extra rows.

assertions.expected:
Sample ID,Stock (mg/mL),Target (mg/mL),Final volume (mL),Stock volume (mL),Diluent volume (mL)
EXPORT-A,3.000,1.000,1.000,0.333,0.667
EXPORT-Z,10.000,2.000,10.000,2.000,8.000
